title: Analyse a whole conversation
lede: Upload a WhatsApp chat export (or a Messenger JSON export). We read who said what and when, and run one real analysis across the whole thing.

upload.label: Upload a chat export
upload.hint: WhatsApp: open the chat, Export chat, Without media (.txt). Messenger: Download your information, a conversation, as JSON.
upload.invalid: That file doesn't look like a WhatsApp or Messenger export.
upload.empty: We couldn't find any messages in that export.

who.title: Which participant are you?
who.hint: Only the other person's messages are analysed; yours are shown for context.

header.truncated: Only the most recent messages were analysed; this export was longer than one check covers.

story.title: How the story changed
story.empty: No playbook stage was detected in this conversation.

empty.title: No conversation loaded yet.
empty.body: Upload a chat export above to see the full analysis.

errors.tooManyMessages: This export has more than {max} messages; only the most recent {max} were analysed.
errors.network: Something went wrong reading that file. Please try again.

sourceNote: Only the redacted, size-limited text of this conversation is sent for analysis; the export itself stays on this device.
